truths.CP2:
SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM orders AS o
JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone(s.timezone, o.order_ts)) AS DATE)
   <> CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE)
truths.CP4:
WITH moved AS (  -- one row per order the report books in another month
  SELECT o.order_id
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN stores AS s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
  WHERE date_trunc('month', CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone(s.timezone, o.order_ts)) AS DATE))
     <> date_trunc('month', CAST(timezone('Europe/Amsterdam', timezone('UTC', o.order_ts)) AS DATE))
)
SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * ol.unit_price_eur - ol.line_discount_eur), 0), 2)
FROM order_lines AS ol
JOIN moved AS m ON m.order_id = ol.order_id
